points.description: Defines DHCP as a network management protocol in which a DHCP server dynamically assigns IP addresses (and other network configuration parameters) to devices on the network, and states its use, e.g. simplifying installation/configuration of end systems (automatic configuration). Equivalent wording accepted.

rubric.notes: Full mark: DHCP identified as a protocol where a server dynamically assigns IP addresses/configuration to hosts, with its purpose (automatic, simplified configuration). Half or none: only one of definition or use gives partial credit at the teacher's discretion; no relevant idea earns zero. Mention of replacing RARP/BOOTP is not required.
